title: what the product refuses, and whether it says why
rule: POST /items with a blank title is 422 and names the field
POST /items with an unknown state is 422 and names the field
a refused write returns no id, so there is nothing to have stored

steps.name: a blank title is refused, and the field is named — an error that does not say WHICH field is a support ticket
a state the vocabulary does not have is refused, and the answer names the vocabulary
a title past the limit is refused by length, not truncated in silence
the collection still answers after three refusals — a validator that wedges the store is worse than one that lets the row through
